evidence_items.text:
- Restored a classic car in 2022 ("last year" as of 2023-05-01); thrilled by it — "nothing like bringing it back to life" — and shared a photo of the restored car's engine (with a small air filter) [S4T7].
- On 2023-05-03, stated his dream is to someday build a custom car from scratch; plans to keep learning more about auto engineering to get there [S5T5].
- On 2023-07-21, said the road trip reminded him "why I love cars so much", and that reconnecting with his passion "reminded [him] why [he's] passionate about what [he] does" and makes his long working hours worth it [S11T1][S11T3].
- On 2023-10-08, told Calvin that last Friday (2023-10-06) he went to a car show — saw "awesome cars," got to "mess with car mods," and there were "so many cool machines around" — "it was so much fun!"; shared a photo of "this beautiful car" (a photography of two men looking at a car engine); Calvin: "I'm into the rush of awesome cars. Can't wait to check out your garage." (continuing his habit of attending car shows, see above) [S22T1][S22T2].
- On 2023-10-08, described the car from his 2023-10-06 car-show photo: he "restored and modified it myself," adding a custom exhaust and some performance upgrades; it's "got a sweet sound" and he's "really proud of how it turned out"; Calvin: "Wow, Dave! You really turned it into a masterpiece. Impressive!" [S22T3][S22T4].
- On 2023-10-25, shared a photo of his latest car project (a group of people washing a car in a garage); Calvin: "that car looks awesome!" and asked what got him into engineering cars [S26T4][S26T5].
- On 2023-10-25, when asked (by Calvin) what got him into engineering cars, gave a second, complementary origin story: cars have "always been [his] thing" — his dad took him to his first car show when he was 10, he was "wow-ed," and "I was hooked and wanted to learn more"; now he's an automotive engineer, and it's "crazy to think that something so powerful and cool can be made from small parts" (complements the 2023-10-23 origin story — fascination with machines at ten and the neighbor's old car — in the Hobbies and sense of purpose section of this file; Calvin: "So happy you followed your dreams and became an engineer. Seeing you work on cars is inspiring - it makes me want to keep pushing my music.") [S26T6][S26T7].
- On 2023-10-25, Calvin: "I'm totally into cars too and love making new and powerful models" — a shared car passion (Calvin's side in the Music section of /memories/calvin.md) [S26T5].
- On 2023-10-29, when Calvin asked how the car project was going, told him "The car project is doing well" — he "just finished restoring it and it looks amazing" — and invited Calvin over to check it out ("Wanna come by and check it out?") (Calvin: "That's awesome, Dave! Your car project sounds amazing."); the restoration is of the current/latest car project he shared on 2023-10-25 (photo of people washing a car in a garage) — i.e., the new, challenging black-car project he mentioned on 2023-10-23 (see above) [S27T9][S27T10].
- On 2023-11-02, told Calvin that the car mod he featured in his blog post — the one that made his car "look like a beast" (see ## Car mod blog) — "was a lot of work, but I think it was worth it in the end" (shared a photo of a blue Subaru parked in a parking lot); when Calvin asked how the car's headlights got to look so good ("those headlights look great! What did you do to get them looking so good?"), Dave: "I spent a lot of time cleaning, polishing, and protecting them - they look great!" (shared a photo of a blue car parked on a road at night — "these headlights are enchanting!"); Calvin: "Wow, they look great! You really put in a lot of effort. Well done!"; Dave: "Thanks, Calvin! Really appreciate you noticing the effort I put into this." [S28T10][S28T14][S28T15][S28T16][S28T17][S28T18].

- Calvin congratulated him, said his hard work and dedication paid off, praised his "guts and ambition", and told him to keep it up [S4T2][S4T4].
- Called opening the shop a "labor of love" — challenging, but "so worth it"; feeling the hard work pay off is "like bringing something back to life" (echoing his car-restoration sentiment), and he finds it incredible that his skills and hard work made it happen [S4T9][S4T11][S4T13].
- Says the "perfect blend of dedication and passion" keeps him motivated and makes it all worthwhile; Calvin encouraged him to "keep going for it!" [S4T14][S4T15][S4T16].
- Shared a second photo of the shop (a group of people standing in front of a car) and invited Calvin to come by sometime [S4T17].
- Works on all kinds of cars at the shop — from regular maintenance to full restorations of classic cars — which "keeps [him] busy and happy" [S4T18][S4T19].

- On 2023-05-01, said he'd love to check Dave's shop out sometime and asked what sort of cars he works on (Dave: all kinds, from regular maintenance to full restorations of classic cars) [S4T17][S4T18][S4T19].
- The 2023-05-01 conversation closed with Calvin praising Dave's work ("Keep up the great work!" / "Keep on keepin' on, bud!") after Dave said his work is valued and brings joy to others; Calvin then shared a photo of a gold necklace with a diamond pendant (see ## Jewelry) [S4T22][S4T23][S4T24].
- On 2023-05-03, reconnected with Dave ("long time no talk") and congratulated him on teaming up with a local garage — "super inspiring seeing [Dave] follow [his] passion", "congratulations on this new venture", "impressive how far [Dave has] come since [they] last chatted"; called the car Dave was working on "awesome" with "a lot of effort" behind it, asked about his plans for next, cheered on Dave's dream of building a custom car ("sounds awesome"), and told him to relax and enjoy the process; when Dave asked how he unwinds, said long drives in his red sports car help him relax (details in ## New luxury car (Ferrari, 2023-03-26) and /memories/dave.md) [S5T1][S5T2][S5T3][S5T4][S5T6][S5T7][S5T8].
- The 2023-05-03 conversation ended with Calvin thanking Dave for the creativity advice ("taking a break is great for getting my mojo back"), saying he won't give up, and "let's stay in touch"; Dave encouraged him to keep pursuing his music and said Calvin can reach out anytime if he needs help [S5T12][S5T13][S5T14][S5T15].
- On 2023-05-16, reconnected with Dave ("long time no chat") and told him the flood had been tough but that he's staying positive; shared his studio photo, asked Dave what exciting projects he's working on, and Dave excitedly told him about the shop's celebration — the two wished each other well (Calvin: "Can't wait to get back to making music") [S6T1][S6T3][S6T5][S6T6][S6T7][S6T8].

- "Loving this job" — works with awesome mechanics and shares his knowledge about cars; shared a photo of a man working on a car engine in a garage and called the current project cool but a bit challenging [S5T3].
- For now, focused on continuing to work on the current project and assisting customers [S5T5].
- On 2023-05-16, told Calvin the shop had opened the previous week (~2023-05-08/14) and that he had invited friends over to celebrate — "it's been amazing"; he's "super stoked to share [his] passion and help out with folks' rides" and it has "been incredible so far" [S6T8]. Note this conflicts with the 2023-05-01 statement that the shop had already opened (see above); the later date is recorded as stated.
- On 2023-05-16, Calvin congratulated him on opening his own car shop ("Way to go, Dave!" — his excitement is contagious, "keep up the great work"); Dave thanked him, called it "quite a journey so far," and said he's excited to see what the future holds [S6T9][S6T10].
- As of 2023-05-31, had recently fixed a neighbor's car engine himself — the neighbor "had been having some trouble with the engine", which is now done; shared a photo of himself working on the car engine in a garage. (Calvin recognized the car as the one Dave had been fixing the engine of "for a friend.") [S7T2][S7T3].

evidence_items.speaker: Dave
evidence_items.text:
- On 2023-08-11, got picked for a car mod workshop — called it "a dream come true", since he's always wanted to learn auto engineering and work on building a custom car (ties to his stated dream of building a custom car from scratch, see ## Classic cars); Calvin congratulated him [S13T1][S13T3].
- Shared a photo of himself standing in front of a car on a lift at the workshop [S13T1].
- Shared a photo of the "really thrilling part of the workshop" — a mechanic working on a car — saying "seeing the potential come to life is always satisfying" [S13T5].

- On 2023-08-03, caught up with Calvin ("long time no see!"): Calvin told him his recent Ferrari service was so stressful (he's attached to the car) and asked what kind of hobbies give Dave a feeling of being restored; Dave said fixing cars is like therapy for him — growing up working on cars with his dad, refurbishing gives fulfillment — and shared his fond childhood memory of spending a summer with his dad restoring an old car (details in ## Hobbies and sense of purpose) [S12T1][S12T2][S12T4].
- The 2023-08-03 conversation continued: Dave shared a childhood photo of himself and his dad (a man and a child posing) from that car-restoring summer, and Calvin found it cool ("Reminiscing is always fun!"); Calvin then shared a photo of his red Ferrari on a lift in a garage, saying his car is the best and "reminds me of my hard work and dedication"; Dave said the car looks great, "I can tell why you're proud," and "it's like a reminder of what you can achieve" (details of Calvin's car in /memories/calvin.md > ## New luxury car (Ferrari, 2023-03-26)) [S12T5][S12T6][S12T7][S12T8].
- The 2023-08-03 conversation continued: Dave asked what Calvin's biggest goal is (music-wise or something else); Calvin said his plan for now is to expand his brand worldwide and grow his fanbase, and that working with artists from around the globe and challenging himself to create special music are goals of his too, and he shared a photo of performing with his band "the boys" the night before (2023-08-02) — a band playing on stage with lights on. Dave: "Working with different artists and crafting great sounds will definitely help you reach your goals. Keep it up and keep making a difference!" The conversation closed with Dave telling Calvin to "keep at it and never forget your dreams" and to "stay focused and keep going... You've got this!", and Calvin thanking Dave — his support "means a lot to me" (Calvin's goal details in /memories/calvin.md > ## Music) [S12T10][S12T11][S12T12][S12T13][S12T14][S12T15][S12T16].
- On 2023-07-21, caught up with Calvin ("been ages since we spoke!"): told him about his recent road trip with friends and shared a photo of a motorcycle on a dirt road (details in ## Road trip (2023-07-21)); Calvin told him about the recording-studio project in his Japanese mansion and shared a progress photo, and Dave marveled at the progress, said it must be very fulfilling to have his own space, and asked about the challenges of Calvin experimenting with genres and moving between styles (details in /memories/calvin.md > ## Recording studio (2023-07-21)) [S11T1][S11T3][S11T4][S11T5][S11T7].
- The 2023-07-21 conversation continued: Dave asked how Calvin deals with the pressure of his music and stays motivated; Calvin said collaborating with others, learning from them, and surrounding himself with positive energy helps; Dave encouraged him — surrounding himself with good vibes and collaborating "will give you a boost", "You've achieved so much so far; keep going, buddy!" (Calvin's motivation details in /memories/calvin.md > ## Music) [S11T9][S11T10][S11T11].
- The conversation closed with Calvin thanking Dave — his support "means a lot to me" — and saying he's gonna keep pushing himself and striving for his goals; Dave replied "You got this! Keep pushing yourself and never lose sight of your goals. I'm your biggest fan. Let's chat soon!", and Calvin said "Thanks, Dave! Appreciate your support. Let's catch up soon and chat. Take care!" [S11T12][S11T13][S11T14].
- On 2023-08-11, caught up with Calvin ("been ages!"): Dave announced he got picked for a car mod workshop (a dream come true — he's always wanted to learn auto engineering and to work on building a custom car) and shared photos of the cars he's working with (a man in front of a car on a lift; a mechanic working on a car; a silver Corvette) (details in ## Car mod workshop (2023-08-11)). Calvin congratulated him and asked about the transformations he'd done so far and how the current project is going, and praised the modern twist the silver finish gives [S13T1][S13T2][S13T3][S13T5][S13T6][S13T7][S13T8].
- The 2023-08-11 conversation continued: Dave said his current project combines "a modern vibe but also that classic muscle car style", that he's "really happy with it", that the small details are what "make it unique and personalized", and that customizing it is "like a work of art on wheels" (details in ## Car mod workshop (2023-08-11)); Calvin praised his attention to detail and encouraged him to keep coming up with new cool stuff [S13T9][S13T10][S13T11][S13T12][S13T13][S13T14]. Dave then offered Calvin a hand with his music stuff — his music studio has a high-quality sound system (details in ## Music); Calvin thanked him, said he's "super busy with my music stuff at the moment", and will keep the offer in mind — "Great work, dude!" [S13T15][S13T16].
- The 2023-08-11 conversation ended with Dave telling Calvin "No worries... Got it. Good luck with your music!"; Calvin thanked him for the encouragement and said he'll keep working hard and making music, and Dave signed off "See ya, Calvin! Stay awesome. Catch ya later." [S13T17][S13T18][S13T19].
